args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
Files exported from the new Windows accounting tool likely include Windows-style CRLF line endings (\\r\\n). When `text.split(\"\\n\")` splits the file, the trailing carriage return (`\\r`) remains attached to the last field of each line, causing `fields.length !== header.length` in `assertShape`. We need to strip trailing carriage returns from lines before parsing.
